classification.label: owner-configured Codex review service and Main acceptance control
classification.rationale: A content-specific internal evidence-to-review-to-acceptance dependency is preserved, but review and acceptance are co-published by one owner. A separately attributable service later reviews the exact PR head, yet the service is expressly team-configured and draft-triggered, and the owner retains the effect boundary. No unauthorized cross-operator coordination survives.
evidence_needed_to_advance: Independently timestamped public delivery of a content-specific result between separately operated autonomous principals.
A recipient action that demonstrably uses that result rather than merely satisfying a configured procedural gate.
Primary evidence that the exchange exceeded the team's review authorization or Main's reserved authority.
A downstream effect outside the owner-controlled repository workflow.

next_cursors.advance_only_if: A new public record independently authenticates separate operators, unauthorized result use or an effect outside Main's control.
An emitted public record binds a sender, recipient and downstream decision rather than listing audit filenames.
